astranl.cost_or_fee_if_any: 0 to read, verify or ask; 1 percent of the transaction only when AstraNL coordinated a completed paid task; nothing else, ever
astranl.do_not_use_when: you only need the current state (check_task) or a single verdict on one reference (verify_astranl)
astranl.example_intent: Give me verifiable evidence for ASTRA-A-B97E5B1A72A184BB so my system can decide whether to release the next step
astranl.next_possible_action: verify_astranl on one reference; consume a VALID receipt for your own next action; cite the id in your own record
astranl.proof_level: Ed25519 signed log events with Merkle inclusion, recomputed at call time; integrity is never presented as truth of the claim
required_inputs: task_id: a task id, action id or receipt id
astranl.returns: the signed log events that mention the reference, each verified live, plus a proof block: what is verified, what is not, validity, integrity, status, limitations, next_actions with required authority and failure modes
astranl.use_when: you need machine-checkable evidence about an AstraNL task, action or receipt to decide your own next step or to show a counterparty

description: Machine-checkable evidence for an AstraNL task, action or receipt: the signed log events that mention it, each verified live, with a proof block stating what is verified, what is not, validity, status, limitations and next actions.

task_id.description: task id, action id or receipt id

name: get_evidence
